channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump Suggests Withdrawing Blanche's AG Nomination Over GOP Opposition
item.description: Senator John Cornyn continues to block Todd Blanche's confirmation as attorney general, citing new concerns that have emerged.

item.title: Former Goldman Sachs lawyer tells House panel Epstein generated millions for firm
item.description: Ex-Goldman Sachs lawyer Kathy Ruemmler testified that Jeffrey Epstein brought in millions of dollars for the firm, according to a transcript.

item.title: Mortgage rates reach one-year high as inflation worries grow
item.description: Mortgage rates are climbing due to inflation concerns linked to the Fed's rate decision and Middle East tensions.

item.title: George and Amal Clooney send note to mayor while evacuating French home due to fires
item.description: The couple left their southeastern France home as wildfires spread through the area.
